posts.title: A Brief Introduction to OxCaml Modes
posts.description: ← 2026-08-31 A Brief Introduction to OxCaml Modes Having recently read through the paper on OxCaml , the basic idea of modes as qualifiers on types was simple enough to grasp. A mode is a combination of three axes of qualifiers that determine how many times a value can be used, if a value has only reference to it and if a value can live beyond the region it is defined in.
